goal: 카메라에서 물체와 수용구의 형상·크기·방향·삽입 가능성을 이해해 명령대로 조작하고, 최소 10걸음 연속 교대 보행을 학습 정책으로 재현한다.
active_hypotheses: Fresh-state MuJoCo candidate rollouts can improve first-attempt physical task selection.
Feedback control generalizes better than nominal open-loop control under moderate dynamics variation.
A fixed open-source robot model can reuse FDB candidate simulation and objective evaluation boundaries.
A shared observation and recovery policy can transfer across humanoids after morphology-aware normalization.
Human motion reference tracking will produce more human-like gait than procedural sinusoidal targets.
Ordered manipulation with OOD rejection and retry recovery can compose existing FDB skills.
A two-tower visual network can learn object-receptacle compatibility and rotation from pixels.
Ten-step alternating human reference motion can supervise a contact-aware neural gait policy.
Fresh-state candidate simulation can recover moderate visual rotation errors before retrying insertion.
unresolved_questions: How should rotate be evaluated independently from translation?
Which orientation representation and collision metric should gate pre-grasp reach?
How should balance observations and task scores be normalized across humanoids of different size and capability?
Which CMU or LAFAN1 gait clip gives the cleanest heel-strike and toe-off labels after retargeting?
Can the same reference gait be retargeted to H1, G1, and Cassie without morphology-specific reward tuning?
How much real-camera domain randomization is needed before physical hardware transfer?
Can a learned residual policy reproduce all ten alternating steps under physics instead of kinematic playback?
next_gate: 100만 step PPO의 1.39초 생존·0 touchdown을 넘어, 접촉 전환·몸통 자세 보상과 초기 상태 커리큘럼을 추가해 체크포인트를 수천만 step까지 재개한다. 조작은 원·삼각형·직사각형 수용구로 확장한다.
